paragraphs.text: Szarel is an Eumidian druid from the Edge .

On Evendo , Szarel is the lead officer for the current stage of the Eumidian terrasymbiosis process. Terrasymbiosis is an Eumidian technique of terraforming planets while the Eumidians' internal biology simultaneously adapts to the world they're converting into a verdant and habitable home. This mutual adaptation strategy dramatically speeds up the process, efficiently seeding Eumidians across the stars.

However, the weight of Szarel's task on Evendo is enormous—he must manage the terrasymbiosis of the world while defending it from Kav colonists who attempt to claim it for themselves. Szarel is fully aware that he will not live to see the project's completion, but he has committed his life to advancing the cause."
